**LOGO / BRANDING**
> **Celsius**
> *Experts in keeping things cool*
> (Located in the top right corner. Features the brand name "Celsius" in a bold, dark blue sans-serif font. To the left of the text is a stylized icon consisting of three wavy horizontal lines, resembling airflow or cooling waves. Below the main brand name is the tagline in a smaller font size.)

**PAGE NUMBER**
> **14**
> (Located in the bottom left corner inside a dark blue rounded square.)

**HEADLINE**
> **TROUBLESHOOTING A/C BREAKDOWNS:**
> (Large, bold text with a color gradient transitioning from light cyan/teal on the left to a darker blue on the right.)

**SUB-HEADLINE**
> **Common Categories**
> (Dark grey, bold sans-serif font located immediately below the main headline.)

**BODY TEXT - CASE STUDY 1**
> **1. A/C Breakdown Case Study: Gas Leak**
>
> **Issue:** Gas leak impacting A/C performance.
>
> **Solution:** Identified, fixed leak, vacuumed, and gas refill.
>
> **Outcome:** Restored optimal cooling efficiency.
>
> **Conclusion:** Timely resolution ensures prolonged A/C functionality

**VISUAL CONTENT DESCRIPTIONS**
*   **Image 1 (Top Right):** A photograph showing two technicians working outdoors. One technician in a blue shirt with "Celsius" printed on the back is crouched down working on an outdoor condenser unit. Various tools and a green gas cylinder are visible on the ground nearby.
*   **Image 2 (Bottom Left):** A close-up photo of an outdoor A/C unit with its panel removed, exposing internal wiring and components. A green refrigerant tank stands vertically next to the unit.
*   **Image 3 (Bottom Center-Left):** A photo of a wall-mounted outdoor unit with the front casing removed, revealing the internal circuit board and wiring. Hoses are connected to the service ports.
*   **Image 4 (Bottom Center-Right):** A photo showing an A/C unit laid on its side or disassembled on the ground, surrounded by tools, gauges, and a yellow canister.
*   **Image 5 (Bottom Right):** A photo of a large commercial or industrial outdoor A/C unit sitting on a wet surface, featuring a large fan and connected piping.

**COLOR SWATCHES / DESIGN ELEMENTS**
*   **Background:** White with a large, abstract light blue shape curving in from the top left corner.
*   **Accent Colors:**
    *   **Teal/Cyan (#00AEEF approx):** Used for the first half of the main headline gradient.
    *   **Dark Blue (#0072BC approx):** Used for the second half of the headline gradient, the page number box, and the logo text.
    *   **Grey (#58595B approx):** Used for the sub-headline "Common Categories".
